sentences.en: There were nineteen graduates for the batch of Spanish class.
sentences.zh: 西班牙班有十九名毕业生。

sentences.en: Another batch of cookies are coming out of the oven.
sentences.zh: 又有一批饼干从烤箱里出来了。

sentences.en: The last batch of cookies is still in the oven.
sentences.zh: 最后一批饼干还在烤箱里。

senses.zh: 一批，一组，一批次；（烘焙的）一批，一炉
